issues.issue: The function is taken from the department column 'General'. That column also holds law enforcement, which the extractor itself moved to public safety, so the column does not clearly name a single function. general government is defensible.

The same label 'Charges for services' is Recreation Fees in the Pool and Park columns (detail[11], detail[14]) but charges for services/fees elsewhere (General detail[5], Senior Center, statement receipts[7]). This rests on the department column and is defensible, but the same label has different categories.
The label is only 'Intergovernmental'. Highway allocation is assumed from the fund name, and no breakdown is printed.

issues.on_page: Water expenses 241,895 (Statement of Activities p2); p7 prints operating 90,135 and nonoperating (151,760) separately
issues.issue: The utility expenditure totals for Water (241,895) and Sewer (detail_totals[13], 84,243) cite the Statement of Activities. The amounts are right and equal the p7 operating plus nonoperating expenses, but they come from the government-wide statement, not the proprietary statement the detail lines are drawn from.
